entries.alt: Four fictional adult women relax around a terrace couch beside the monumental Pinecone Courtyard: one rests her head on another's shoulder, a third sits on the parapet and a fourth crouches beside them. They wear short gold, yellow-and-white Vatican flag and blue looks with metallic heels and rainbow platforms; distant fictional fires and smoke rise over the city.

Four fictional adult women gather in a close side-hug and supported seated pose beneath the Momo double-helix staircase, wearing short yellow, white and bronze looks with Vatican key-and-tiara motifs, rainbow knee-highs and gold, ivory, blue RAZE and bronze heels.

Four fictional adult women lean together and join hands in the Vatican Gallery of Maps, wearing short blue, yellow-white flag and cartographic looks with rainbow knee-highs, gold platforms, a white boot, a blue RAZE boot and bronze stilettos.

Four fictional adult women share a close overlapping embrace and linked hands in the Vatican Gardens beside clipped hedges and a fountain, wearing short bronze, pearl-gold, blue map-pattern and yellow-white flag looks with visible heart, silent king and GRD tattoos.
